description: This plot, titled “Whisper fine-tuning, type = small,” illustrates the Word Error Rate (WER) on the y-axis, which ranges from 25.0 to 42.5, against the number of epochs on the x-axis, which ranges from 0 to 6. The y-axis is linearly scaled with labeled tick marks at intervals of 2.5, and the x-axis is linearly scaled with integer tick marks. Four distinct lines represent different model configurations: “small AdaLoRA_int4” (orange dashed line with circle markers), “small AdaLoRA_int8” (orange dash-dotted line with square markers), “small int4” (orange solid line with triangle markers), and “small int8” (orange dotted line with diamond markers). At epoch 0, the WER values are approximately 30.0, 35.0, 32.5, and 30.0, respectively. The “small AdaLoRA_int4” line peaks at epoch 2 with a WER of approximately 42.0 before declining. The “small int4” line shows a steady decline from 30.0 to approximately 25.0 by epoch 6. The “small int8” line starts at 30.0 and ends at approximately 25.0, with a slight dip around epoch 3. The “small AdaLoRA_int8” line starts at 35.0, peaks at epoch 2 with a WER of approximately 40.0, then declines to approximately 25.0 by epoch 6.
